info.headline: Notify NYC - Missing Vulnerable Adult Alert - Henry Ackie (NYC)
info.description:
Alert issued 10-09-2026 at 06:58 PM.
A Missing Vulnerable Adult Alert has been issued for Henry Ackie, a 75-year-old black male from Brooklyn, Kings County. The missing may be in need of medical attention.
Description: 5'6" tall, 150lbs, with gray hair and brown eyes. Wearing a burgundy shirt with black sleeves, blue shorts, and brown slippers.
Last Seen: East 48th Street in Brooklyn, NY at approximately 8:00 PM on 10-08-2026.
If you see the missing person, please call NYCPD Missing Person Squad at 800-577-8477 or call 9-1-1.
A photo of the missing is available here: https://flic.kr/p/2sFo7Qm
